comment: * Describes how the blocked empty state should look like for a profile tab

methods.name: String getTitle()
methods.comment: * Title that will be shown on the empty state

methods.name: String getSubtitle()
methods.comment: * Subtitle that will be shown underneath the title on the empty state

methods.name: ClickListener getButtonClickListener()
methods.comment:
* If non-null then a button will be shown and this listener will be called
         * when the button is clicked

methods.name: boolean useDefaultEmptyView()
methods.comment:
* If true then default text ('No apps can perform this action') and style for the empty
         * state will be applied, title and subtitle will be ignored.

methods.name: boolean shouldSkipDataRebuild()
methods.comment:
* Returns true if for this empty state we should skip rebuilding of the apps list
         * for this tab.

methods.name: void onEmptyStateShown()
methods.comment: * Called when empty state is shown, could be used e.g. to track analytics events
